question: 2026년 1월 매출 알려줘
gold_sql: SELECT SUM(o.items_ex_vat) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE r.refund_type WHEN 'FULL' THEN o.items_ex_vat ELSE r.refund_amount * 100 / 110 END), 0) FROM orders o LEFT JOIN refunds r USING (order_id) WHERE o.paid_at IS NOT NULL AND strftime('%Y-%m', o.paid_at) IN ('2026-01')
